rows.name: Alabama Council on Developmental Disabilities
rows.mandate: Alabama's federally mandated DD council driving systems change and inclusion. Thirty-six governor-appointed volunteer members including self-advocates, family members, and agency representatives.
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Code of Alabama; AL publishes no central board directory (inventory mode)

rows.name: Alabama Board of Nursing
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Alabama's nurses. Thirteen members appointed by the Governor from nominee lists — eight registered nurses and four licensed practical nurses plus a consumer (Code of Ala. § 34-21-2).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Code of Alabama; AL publishes no central board directory (inventory mode)

rows.name: Alabama Board of Pardons and Paroles
rows.constituent: Alabamians in the parole & clemency system
rows.mandate: Decides parole, pardons, and clemency in Alabama. Three members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent from a nominated slate, six-year terms (Code of Ala. § 15-22-20).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Code of Alabama; AL publishes no central board directory (inventory mode)

rows.name: Alabama Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: Alabamians in real estate transactions & licensees
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Alabama's real estate brokers and salespersons. Nine members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent (Code of Ala. § 34-27-7).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Code of Alabama; AL publishes no central board directory (inventory mode)

rows.name: Advisory Board of Conservation and Natural Resources
rows.mandate: Advises the Alabama Department of Conservation and Natural Resources on game, fish, and state lands. Thirteen members — ten appointed by the Governor (one per congressional district) plus three ex officio (Code of Ala. § 9-2-14).
